env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd client
! logos list -deps .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'
! logos list -json .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'
! logos list -compiled .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'
! logos list p.go
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'

# Shared dependencies and explicitly selected dependencies report once.
! logos list . ./other
cp stderr shared.stderr
grep -count=1 '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed' shared.stderr
! logos list . example.com/mixed/g
cp stderr selected.stderr
grep -count=1 '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed' selected.stderr

# Every selected root retains its structured dependency error under -e.
logos list -e -f '{{.Incomplete}} {{len .DepsErrors}}' . ./other
cp stdout structured.stdout
grep -count=2 '^true 1$' structured.stdout
logos list -e -f '{{.Incomplete}} {{len .DepsErrors}}' p.go
stdout '^true 1$'

# A dependency census that cannot classify a source must also fail closed.
cp bad-header ../mixed/l/l.lgo
! logos list .
stderr 'classifying package example.com/mixed/l in module example.com/mixed:'
logos list -e -f '{{(index .DepsErrors 0).Err}}' .
stdout 'classifying package example.com/mixed/l in module example.com/mixed:'
go list .
stdout '^example.com/client$'

-- client/go.mod --
module example.com/client

go 1.27

require example.com/mixed v0.0.0

replace example.com/mixed => ../mixed
-- client/p.go --
package client

import "example.com/mixed/g"

const Value = g.Value
-- client/other/p.go --
package other

import "example.com/mixed/g"

const Value = g.Value
-- client/bad-header --
package
-- mixed/go.mod --
module example.com/mixed

go 1.27
-- mixed/g/g.go --
package g

const Value = 1
-- mixed/l/l.lgo --
package l
